newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Cricket-Otago in early trouble against CD.
newsitem.headline: Cricket-Otago in early trouble against CD.

text.p: Wanganui, Nov 25 - Young Wanganui pace bowler Andrew Penn snared two early wickets as Central Districts made a strong start against Otago in their Shell Trophy cricket match in Wanganui today. Otago, put into bat, slumped to 17 for the loss of three wickets after just 11 overs.
The pitch was playing well but offered the quickies a bit of bounce and both strike bowlers, Penn and Carl Bulfin, beat the bat several times.
Michael Austen, back for Otago after several years in Wellington, was caught in the gully off Penn for one, and Penn had his second victim when Michael Lamont, on four, played on.
Otago captain Robert Lawson, who scored seven, was the second batsman out, caught by keeper Eric Austin, off Bulfin.
